properties.name: Entra ID authentication strength change
properties.description:
Identifies when the allowed sign-in method combinations of a custom authentication strength are changed in Microsoft Entra ID.
An authentication strength lists the method combinations that satisfy a Conditional Access policy, for example phishing-resistant methods only.
An attacker with the Conditional Access Administrator role could add a weaker method to a strength that a policy already uses, so the policy stays in place but accepts weaker sign-ins.
Creating or deleting a whole strength is not covered, and neither are the advanced options (AAGUIDs and certificate issuers).
The alert shows the combinations before and after the change and the id of the strength.
Ref: https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/authentication/concept-authentication-strengths
properties.query:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2h)
| where ingestion_time() > ago(1h)
| where OperationName =~ "Authentication Strength Policy Update"
| where Result !~ "failure"
| extend InitiatingAppName = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)
| extend InitiatingUserPrincipalName = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend InitiatingAadUserId = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.id)
| extend InitiatingIPAddress = tostring(iff(isnotempty(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress), InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress, InitiatedBy.app.ipAddress))
| extend InitiatingAccountName = tostring(split(InitiatingUserPrincipalName, "@")[0]), InitiatingAccountUPNSuffix = tostring(split(InitiatingUserPrincipalName, "@")[1])
| mv-apply Target = TargetResources on (
    mv-expand Property = Target.modifiedProperties
    | summarize PropertyBag = make_bag(bag_pack(tostring(Property.displayName), bag_pack("old", tostring(Property.oldValue), "new", tostring(Property.newValue))))
  )
| extend CombinationsBefore = trim('"', tostring(PropertyBag.AllowedCombinations.old))
| extend CombinationsAfter = trim('"', tostring(PropertyBag.AllowedCombinations.new))
| extend StrengthId = trim('"', tostring(PropertyBag.Id.new))
| where isnotempty(CombinationsAfter)
| mv-apply Combination = split(CombinationsBefore, "|") to typeof(string) on (
    extend Methods = strcat_array(array_sort_asc(split(replace_string(Combination, " ", ""), ",")), ",")
    | where isnotempty(Methods)
    | summarize NormalizedBefore = tostring(array_sort_asc(make_set(Methods)))
  )
| mv-apply Combination = split(CombinationsAfter, "|") to typeof(string) on (
    extend Methods = strcat_array(array_sort_asc(split(replace_string(Combination, " ", ""), ",")), ",")
    | where isnotempty(Methods)
    | summarize NormalizedAfter = tostring(array_sort_asc(make_set(Methods)))
  )
| where NormalizedBefore != NormalizedAfter
| project-away NormalizedBefore, NormalizedAfter
| project-reorder TimeGenerated, OperationName, StrengthId, CombinationsBefore, CombinationsAfter, InitiatingUserPrincipalName, InitiatingAppName, InitiatingIPAddress
